entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emil Leeb was a German General during the Second World War. A professional soldier, he saw active service during both World Wars. Leeb's older brother Wilhelm Ritter von Leeb was a Generalfeldmarschall of the Wehrmacht during the Second World War.
